reference.source: BEIR BM25 (Anserini, k1 0.9, b 0.4, title and text fields)

notes: One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only. Known gap: served bm25 measures below BEIR's published 0.325 and Pyserini's single-field 0.322; the offline textbook BM25 over the same memories measures 0.318, so most of the gap is the one-body mapping and the analyser (Snowball against Lucene's Porter, hyphenated words kept whole), not the ranking (ADR-0049 d12). Served bm25 over the same seeded sample, on the same host in the same hour, for comparison with bm25-rerank-d20; the full-set bm25 row is the reference run.
